procedures.title: §9.6 E7: Ambient temperature sensor
procedures.purpose: Error code E7 — ambient temperature sensor

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the freezer before resistance checks or harness service.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing electrical parts.

steps.title: Main PCB harness seating
steps.body: Verify ambient temperature sensor connector at main PCB is fully seated with no foreign matter.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace sensor when resistance out of range.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify ambient temperature sensor connector at main PCB is fully seated with no foreign matter.

steps.title: Bench B3839 resistance
steps.body: Disconnect power. Pull sensor connector at main PCB. Measure ambient sensor at hinge/cabinet (§8.1) — B3839 §8.4 R/T (~2.0 kΩ @ 25°C).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Pull sensor connector at main PCB. Measure ambient sensor at hinge/cabinet (§8.1) — B3839 §8.4 R/T (~2.0 kΩ @ 25°C).

steps.title: ambient temperature sensor resistance
steps.body: B3839 NTC — do not use generic 5–16 kΩ cabinet band.
steps.sourceExcerpt: B3839 NTC — do not use generic 5–16 kΩ cabinet band.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace sensor when resistance out of range.

steps.title: Display and main PCB harness
steps.body: Verify display, hinge cover, and main PCB connectors are seated with no foreign matter.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace door when door harness wire is open (∞ Ω).

steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify display, hinge cover, and main PCB connectors are seated with no foreign matter.

steps.title: Wire resistance display ↔ main
steps.body: Pull all connectors. Measure wire resistance between display PCB and main PCB — ∞ Ω indicates broken wire.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Pull all connectors. Measure wire resistance between display PCB and main PCB — ∞ Ω indicates broken wire.

steps.title: Replace display then main
steps.body: If wire OK, replace display control board. If E6 persists, replace main PCB.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace main PCB when display swap failed.

steps.title: Continue in test mode
steps.body: Test mode entered (§9.7). Continue with component-specific checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After test mode entry, proceed with OEM maintenance steps.

steps.title: Access evaporator fan
steps.body: Remove freezer air duct per §7.5. Verify DC 12 V fan motor (2020 r/min spec) is seated on shaft.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove freezer air duct per §7.5. Verify DC 12 V fan motor (2020 r/min spec) is seated on shaft.

steps.title: Forced cooling test
steps.body: Enter test mode (LOCK + − 3 s). Press + for forced cooling (display 1) — compressor and fan should run.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter test mode (LOCK + − 3 s). Press + for forced cooling (display 1) — compressor and fan should run.

steps.title: Fan runs in forced cooling
steps.body: With forced cooling active, does freezer fan rotate and move air?
steps.sourceExcerpt: With forced cooling active, does freezer fan rotate and move air?

steps.sourceExcerpt: After test mode entry, proceed with OEM maintenance steps.

steps.title: Disconnect defrost heater
steps.body: Power off. Disconnect defrost heater with sensor/fuse assembly at evaporator (§7.6).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Disconnect defrost heater with sensor/fuse assembly at evaporator (§7.6).

steps.title: FZ defrost heater resistance
steps.body: 115 V 320 W heater — calculated R ≈ 41 Ω (38–48 Ω normal band).
steps.sourceExcerpt: 115 V 320 W heater — calculated R ≈ 41 Ω (38–48 Ω normal band).
